dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and continuous narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Significant lateral asymmetry; the right margin exhibits a large, smooth convex bulge, while the left margin displays multiple irregular indentations and a concave segment.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with subtle light-grey tonal variations across the dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, dark, high-contrast linear mark follows the central longitudinal axis of the upper dorsal region.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A longitudinal shadow-casting depression is visible along the mid-dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and jagged lateral margins, particularly on the left side, indicating significant structural deviations from a smooth spindle shape.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced right-side lateral mass protrusion creating a non-symmetrical dorsal profile.
